name: Acid Arrow
text: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid.

name: Acid Splash
text: You hurl a bubble of acid.

name: Aid
text: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve.

name: Alarm
text: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion.

name: Alter Self
text: You assume a different form.

name: Animal Friendship
text: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

name: Animal Messenger
text: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message.

name: Animal Shapes
text: Your magic turns others into beasts.

name: Animate Dead
text: This spell creates an undead servant.

name: Animate Objects
text: Objects come to life at your command.

name: Antilife Shell
text: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs.

name: Antimagic Field
text: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
text: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice.

name: Arcane Eye
text: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the durat ion.

name: Arcane Hand
text: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

name: Arcane Lock
text: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration.

name: Arcane Sword
text: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range.

name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
text: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it.

name: Astral Projection
text: You and up to eight willing creatur es within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you are already on that plane).

name: Augury
text: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes.

name: Awaken
text: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant.

name: Bane
text: Up to three creatures of y our choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws.

name: Banishment
text: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence.

name: Barkskin
text: You touch a willing creature.

name: Beacon of Hope
text: This spell bestows hope and vitality.

name: Bestow Curse
text: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell.

name: Black Tentacles
text: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range.

name: Blade Barrier
text: You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy.

name: Bless
text: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

name: Blight
text: Necromantic energy w ashes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it.

name: Blindness/Deafness
text: You can blind or deafen a foe.

name: Blink
text: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell.

name: Blur
text: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you.

name: Branding Smite
text: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike.

name: Burning Hands
text: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.

name: Call Lightning
text: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you.

name: Calm Emotions
text: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people.

name: Chain Lightning
text: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range.

name: Charm Person
text: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

name: Chill Touch
text: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range.

name: Circle of Death
text: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot- radius sphere from a point within range.

name: Clairvoyance
text: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees).

name: Clone
text: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death.

name: Cloudkill
text: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Color Spray
text: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand.

name: Command
text: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range.

name: Commune
text: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answ ered with a yes or no.

name: Commune with Nature
text: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory.

name: Comprehend Languages
text: For the duration, you under stand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear.

name: Compulsion
text: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw.

name: Cone of Cold
text: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands.

name: Confusion
text: This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action.

name: Conjure Animals
text: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

name: Conjure Celestial
text: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

name: Conjure Elemental
text: You call forth an elemental servant.

name: Conjure Fey
text: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a beast of challenge rating 6 or lower.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
text: You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
text: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

name: Contact Other Plane
text: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane.

name: Contagion
text: Your touch inflicts disease.

name: Contingency
text: Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you.

name: Continual Flame
text: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch.

name: Control Water
text: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side.

name: Control Weather
text: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration.

name: Counterspell
text: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

name: Create Food and Water
text: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours.

name: Create or Destroy Water
text: You either create or destroy water.

name: Create Undead
text: You can cast this spell only at night.

name: Creation
text: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving o bject of vegetable matter within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar.

name: Cure Wounds
text: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Dancing Lights
text: You create up to four torch-sized lights withi n range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration.

name: Darkness
text: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration.

name: Darkvision
text: You touch a willing creature to grant i t the ability to see in the dark.

name: Daylight
text: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out fr om a point you choose within range.

name: Death Ward
text: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
text: A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration.

name: Demiplane
text: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range.

name: Detect Evil and Good
text: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located.

name: Detect Magic
text: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
text: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creature s, and diseases within 30 feet of you.

name: Detect Thoughts
text: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures.

name: Dimension Door
text: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range.

name: Disguise Self
text: You make yourself —including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person — look different until the spell ends or u ntil you use your action to dismiss it.

name: Disintegrate
text: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
text: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane.

name: Dispel Magic
text: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range.

name: Divination
text: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants.

name: Divine Favor
text: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance.

name: Divine Word
text: You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation.

name: Dominate Beast
text: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range.

name: Dominate Monster
text: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range.

name: Dominate Person
text: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range.

name: Dream
text: This spell shap es a creature's dreams.

name: Druidcraft
text: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range: • You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your locatio n for the next 24 hours.

name: Earthquake
text: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range.

name: Eldritch Blast
text: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range.

name: Enhance Ability
text: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
text: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration.

name: Entangle
text: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range.

name: Enthrall
text: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw.

name: Etherealness
text: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps w ith your current plane.

name: Expeditious Retreat
text: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace.

name: Eyebite
text: For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dre ad power.

name: Fabricate
text: You convert raw materials into products of the same material.

name: Faerie Fire
text: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice).

name: Faithful Hound
text: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

name: False Life
text: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

name: Fear
text: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears.

name: Feather Fall
text: Choose up to five falling creatures with in range.

name: Feeblemind
text: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality.

name: Find Familiar
text: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

name: Find Steed
text: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it.

name: Find the Path
text: This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence.

name: Find Traps
text: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight.

name: Finger of Death
text: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain.

name: Fireball
text: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

name: Fire Bolt
text: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

name: Fire Shield
text: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

name: Fire Storm
text: A storm made up of sheets of roaring f lame appears in a location you choose within range.

name: Flame Blade
text: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand.

name: Flame Strike
text: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify.

name: Flaming Sphere
text: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration.

name: Flesh to Stone
text: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone.

name: Floating Disk
text: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

name: Fly
text: You touch a willing creature.

name: Fog Cloud
text: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range.

name: Forbiddance
text: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor.

name: Forcecage
text: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range.

name: Foresight
text: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future.

name: Freedom of Movement
text: You touch a willing creature.

name: Freezing Sphere
text: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere.

name: Gaseous Form
text: You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration.

name: Gate
text: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within ra nge to a precise location on a different plane of existence.

name: Geas
text: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, for cing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide.

name: Gentle Repose
text: You touch a corpse or other remains.

name: Giant Insect
text: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms fo r the duration.

name: Glibness
text: Until the spell ends, when you m ake a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
text: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration.

name: Glyph of Warding
text: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest) to conceal the glyph.

name: Goodberry
text: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration.

name: Grease
text: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

name: Greater Invisibility
text: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

name: Greater Restoration
text: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating e ffect.

name: Guardian of Faith
text: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an uno ccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

name: Guards and Wards
text: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares).

name: Guidance
text: You touch one willing creature.

name: Guiding Bolt
text: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range.

name: Gust of Wind
text: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration.

name: Hallow
text: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
text: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain.

name: Harm
text: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range.

name: Haste
text: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range.

name: Heal
text: Choose a creature that you can see within range.

name: Healing Word
text: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Heat Metal
text: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range.

name: Hellish Rebuke
text: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.

name: Heroes' Feast
text: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink.

name: Heroism
text: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery.

name: Hideous Laughter
text: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

name: Hold Monster
text: Choose a creature that you can see within range.

name: Hold Person
text: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range.

name: Holy Aura
text: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you.

name: Hunter's Mark
text: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
text: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range.

name: Ice Storm
text: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

name: Identify
text: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

name: Illusory Script
text: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

name: Imprisonment
text: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range.

name: Incendiary Cloud
text: A swirling cloud of s moke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range.

name: Inflict Wounds
text: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach.

name: Insect Plague
text: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Instant Summons
text: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or le ss.

name: Invisibility
text: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

name: Irresistible Dance
text: Choose one creature that you can see within range.

name: Jump
text: You touch a creature.

name: Knock
text: Choose an object that you can see within range.

name: Legend Lore
text: Name or describe a person, place, or object.

name: Lesser Restoration
text: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it.

name: Levitate
text: One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration.

name: Light
text: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
text: Describe or name a s pecific kind of beast or plant.

name: Locate Creature
text: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you.

name: Locate Object
text: Describe or name an object that is fam iliar to you.

name: Longstrider
text: You touch a creature.

name: Mage Armor
text: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends.

name: Mage Hand
text: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

name: Magic Circle
text: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

name: Magic Jar
text: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component.

name: Magic Missile
text: You create three glowing darts of magical force.

name: Magic Mouth
text: You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met.

name: Magic Weapon
text: You touch a nonmagical weapon.

name: Magnificent Mansion
text: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration.

name: Major Image
text: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
text: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range.

name: Mass Heal
text: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you.

name: Mass Healing Word
text: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Mass Suggestion
text: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you.

name: Maze
text: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane.

name: Meld into Stone
text: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration.

name: Mending
text: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.

name: Message
text: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message.

name: Meteor Swarm
text: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range.

name: Mind Blank
text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.

name: Minor Illusion
text: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

name: Mirage Arcane
text: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain.

name: Mirror Image
text: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space.

name: Mislead
text: You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing.

name: Misty Step
text: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

name: Modify Memory
text: You attempt to reshape another creature's memories.

name: Moonbeam
text: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot- radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

name: Move Earth
text: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range.

name: Nondetection
text: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic.

name: Pass without Trace
text: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection.

name: Passwall
text: A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration.

name: Phantasmal Killer
text: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature.

name: Phantom Steed
text: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

name: Planar Ally
text: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid.

name: Planar Binding
text: With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service.

name: Plane Shift
text: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

name: Plant Growth
text: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area.

name: Poison Spray
text: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

name: Polymorph
text: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form.

name: Power Word Kill
text: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly.

name: Power Word Stun
text: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded.

name: Prayer of Healing
text: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Prestidigitation
text: This spell is a minor magical tric k that novice spellcasters use for practice.

name: Prismatic Spray
text: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand.

name: Prismatic Wall
text: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall —up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick —centered on a point you can see within range.

name: Private Sanctum
text: You make an area within range magically secure.

name: Produce Flame
text: A flickering flame appears in your hand.

name: Programmed Illusion
text: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs.

name: Project Image
text: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration.

name: Protection from Energy
text: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

name: Protection from Poison
text: You touch a creature.

name: Purify Food and Drink
text: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

name: Raise Dead
text: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
text: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range.

name: Ray of Frost
text: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

name: Regenerate
text: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability.

name: Reincarnate
text: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid.

name: Remove Curse
text: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end.

name: Resilient Sphere
text: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range.

name: Resistance
text: You touch one willing creature.

name: Resurrection
text: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead.

name: Reverse Gravity
text: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100- foot high cylinder centered on a point within range.

name: Revivify
text: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute.

name: Rope Trick
text: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long.

name: Sacred Flame
text: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

name: Sanctuary
text: You ward a creature within range against attack.

name: Scorching Ray
text: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range.

name: Scrying
text: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you.

name: Secret Chest
text: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane.

name: See Invisibility
text: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Seeming
text: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range.

name: Sending
text: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar.

name: Sequester
text: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration.

name: Shapechange
text: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration.

name: Shatter
text: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range.

name: Shield
text: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

name: Shield of Faith
text: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Shillelagh
text: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

name: Shocking Grasp
text: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

name: Silence
text: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Silent Image
text: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

name: Simulacrum
text: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell.

name: Sleep
text: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

name: Sleet Storm
text: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Slow
text: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

name: Spare the Dying
text: You touch a living cr eature that has 0 hit points.

name: Speak with Animals
text: You gain the ability to c omprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

name: Speak with Dead
text: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose.

name: Speak with Plants
text: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

name: Spider Climb
text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.

name: Spike Growth
text: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns.

name: Spirit Guardians
text: You call forth spirits to protect you.

name: Spiritual Weapon
text: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again.

name: Stinking Cloud
text: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range.

name: Stone Shape
text: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape t hat suits your purpose.

name: Stoneskin
text: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone.

name: Storm of Vengeance
text: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet.

name: Suggestion
text: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear a nd understand you.

name: Sunbeam
text: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line.

name: Sunburst
text: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Symbol
text: When you cast this sp ell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest).

name: Telekinesis
text: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought.

name: Telepathic Bond
text: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration.

name: Teleport
text: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

name: Teleportation Circle
text: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sig il sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you.

name: Thaumaturgy
text: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

name: Thunderwave
text: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

name: Time Stop
text: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

name: Tiny Hut
text: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration.

name: Tongues
text: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears.

name: Transport via Plants
text: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence.

name: Tree Stride
text: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet.

name: True Polymorph
text: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.

name: True Resurrection
text: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age.

name: True Seeing
text: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are.

name: True Strike
text: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range.

name: Unseen Servant
text: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends.

name: Vampiric Touch
text: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds.

name: Vicious Mockery
text: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

name: Wall of Fire
text: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range.

name: Wall of Force
text: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

name: Wall of Ice
text: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range.

name: Wall of Stone
text: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range.

name: Wall of Thorns
text: You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns.

name: Warding Bond
text: This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends.

name: Water Breathing
text: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends.

name: Water Walk
text: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava —as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

name: Web
text: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range.

name: Weird
text: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them.

name: Wind Walk
text: You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud.

name: Wind Wall
text: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range.

name: Wish
text: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast.

name: Word of Recall
text: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary.

name: Zone of Truth
text: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range.
